steps.name: track-stage21-canonical-replay-fixture
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=bd94bea60fa7c3ca4a9b5420dae40edb9baff14b; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.gitignore'); s=p.read_text(); marker='*.ndjson\n'; exception='!tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson\n'; assert marker in s; p.write_text(s if exception in s else s.replace(marker, marker+exception, 1))"; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py; git add .gitignore; git add -f tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; if git check-ignore -q tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; then echo 'fixture is still ignored' >&2; exit 1; fi; git ls-files --error-unmatch tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; git diff --cached --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage21b-clean-checkout-fixture-guard
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_climate_replay_fixture.py tests/test_climate_replay.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py --output /tmp/climate-runtime-replay-stage21b.ndjson; git show :tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson > /tmp/climate-runtime-replay-staged.ndjson; cmp /tmp/climate-runtime-replay-stage21b.ndjson /tmp/climate-runtime-replay-staged.ndjson; test "$(wc -l < /tmp/climate-runtime-replay-staged.ndjson | tr -d ' ')" = 12; git ls-files --error-unmatch tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; if git check-ignore -q tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; then exit 1; fi; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage21b
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; git add -f tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git ls-files --error-unmatch tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; git diff --check; git add -A; git add -f tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Track canonical climate replay fixture'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
